title: RF-005: Add explicit port conformance checks for storage and observability adapters

changes.summary: Added real adapter conformance checks for BronzeStoragePort, SilverStoragePort, GoldStoragePort, LoggerPort, and CircuitBreakerPort implementations.
Added BronzeWriter.cleanup_bronze() as the BronzeStoragePort cleanup entrypoint, delegating to retained cleanup_old_files().
Added SilverWriter.clear_silver() as the SilverStoragePort clear entrypoint, delegating to the shared Delta table clear helper.
Added GoldWriter.clear_gold() as the GoldStoragePort clear entrypoint, delegating to the shared Delta table clear helper.

not_committed_artifacts.reason: Clean temporary-worktree refresh/check was performed for the RF-005 source changes, but the generated JSON was not included in the final commit because concurrent module-coverage refreshes in the dirty checkout were repeatedly mixing unrelated runtime-builders drift into the artifact.

guardrails: No domain port signatures were weakened.
No explicit inheritance was added before conformance was proven.
No technical-debt budget, hotspot cap, scorecard threshold, ratchet, or exemption limit was increased.
No infrastructure logic was moved into domain ports.

not_completed.reason: Interrupted after more than two minutes without output on the mounted checkout; explicit inheritance was not added, and architecture/import/conformance checks passed.
Temporary worktree checkout lacked generated reports/quality/flaky-test-burndown-review.json, so the aggregate report could not build.
